title: Adding a task
note: Recorded from the demo site with sample data.

shot.title: Adding a task
shot.body: Three clicks from the board to a new task, and the summary keeps up.

shot.title: Start from the board
shot.body: The New task button sits at the top right.

shot.title: Fill in the task
shot.body: A title, an owner and a day. Nothing else is required.

shot.title: It lands on the board
shot.body: The new row appears in this week's table.

shot.title: And the summary counts it
shot.body: Far down the page, the summary now reads 3 tasks. The frame scrolls to it on its own.
